s2_definition.trigger: a confirmed BOS (Break of Structure) on the M15 decision timeframe -- a fractal-confirmed swing broken on CANDLE CLOSE only, never a wick (structurally enforced: BOSEvent is only ever produced by a close-break)
s2_definition.regime_gate: regime must be TREND_UP (for LONG) or TREND_DOWN (for SHORT) -- classified from EMA20/EMA50 + range_max_pips, NOT from a fixed reference-session breakout
s2_definition.reference_session_range: NOT part of S2's own gate at all -- a session reference range (00:00-06:00 or 06:00-11:00 UTC) is used elsewhere in the engine for S1 (sweep reversal) and regime classification inputs, not as an S2 breakout boundary
s2_definition.displacement: OPTIONAL evidence field only (`displacement_confirmed`, sourced from bos.displacement_confirmed) -- config explicitly sets `bos.require_displacement_confirmation: false`, i.e. NOT a required gate for S2 in the current signed config, contradicting an ATR-multiple displacement requirement
s2_definition.retest: NOT part of S2 at all -- a retest/confirmation-score mechanism (breakout_level_retest, ema20_retest, eligible_fvg_retrace, pullback_liquidity_sweep, displacement_reconfirmation, >= continuation_score.minimum of 2) exists ONLY for S3 (Pullback Continuation), a separate setup model
s2_definition.entry: immediate, at bos.close_price -- no separate confirmation candle or retest wait
s2_definition.stop: structural_stop_distance = abs(entry - structural_anchor) + stop_buffer_multiplier(0.20) * ATR_M15(period=14) -- matches the mission's stop_buffer_atr=0.20 by coincidence, but the structural_anchor is the broken swing, not a 'displacement leg origin'
s2_definition.target: trade_management.runner_target_r = 3.0 (not 2.0), with a 50% partial via NEXT_LIQUIDITY_TARGET mode, not a flat single R multiple

material_differences: AG's real S2 has NO retest or confirmation-candle requirement; the mission's example spec makes both mandatory, multi-bar gates. This is the single largest structural difference -- the mission's spec more closely resembles AG's own S3 (Pullback Continuation) continuation-score mechanism than its S2.

AG's real S2 has NO fixed reference-session breakout boundary; entry is triggered by a fractal BOS anywhere in the trend, not a session-range close-break. AG's session reference range belongs to S1 and to regime inputs, not S2.
AG's real S2 treats displacement as optional/evidence-only (require_displacement_confirmation: false in the signed config); the mission's spec makes displacement a hard, threshold-gated requirement.
Target R differs: AG's signed default is a 3.0R runner with a 50% partial exit; the mission's example is a flat 2.0R single target.
Only the stop-buffer ATR multiplier (0.20) matches by apparent coincidence -- not sufficient to treat the two specs as compatible.
